sanskrit_verse:
प्रमाणसमतायां तु राजाज्ञानिर्णयः स्मृतः ।
शास्त्रसभ्याविरोधेन चतुर्थः परिकीर्तितः ॥
transliteration: pramāṇasamatāyāṃ tu rājājñā nirṇayaḥ smṛtaḥ | śāstrasabhyāvirodhena caturthaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When all pramāṇas are equal in weight, the decision of the King stands as judgment; when there is contradiction with śāstra or sabhā, a fourth method of resolution is declared.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from the realized sovereign who embodies dharma-vision
Causation is determined through pramāṇa parity and not subjective interpretation
Capacity-based responsibility lies with the one who holds both vision and executive alignment
Restoration logic operates through harmonizing contradictory evidentiary sources
Consciousness alignment determines validity of legal precedence
executable_legal_axioms: IF pramāṇa_weights == EQUAL THEN rājājñā = FINAL_JUDGMENT
IF śāstra_contradiction EXISTS AND sabhā_agreement EXISTS THEN invoke_caturtha_nirṇaya
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when textual, customary, and testimonial pramāṇas yield equipoise, the ruling of the sovereign authority informed by dharma-vision shall prevail. Contradictions involving śāstra or assembly consensus necessitate invocation of the fourth mode of resolution, which aligns with the consciousness-state of the adjudicator.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa parity establishes epistemic equipoise requiring sovereign discernment rather than punitive action. The sequential manifestation of evidence (anupūrvaśaḥ) ensures that no actor incurs artificial consequence; instead, reality realigns through capacity restoration and integrity completion.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate pramāṇa parity audit to verify evidentiary equilibrium
Summon rājājñā only after dharma-advisor confirms śāstra alignment
Engage sabhā council to resolve śāstra-sabhā conflict via consciousness convergence
Assign karmic-integrity monitor to ensure non-retrogressive enforcement
Execute dharma-pratipatti protocol for all involved parties post-judgment
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this judgment restores Dharma through pramāṇa alignment, upholds the supremacy of consciousness over punitive frameworks, and affirms the King's role as executor of realized truth. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the ultimate adjudicator.
